description: Every test with a counted run in the period, CI and local (source=ci or source=local narrows it), one row per test across its Playwright projects - testName is the name without the project, projects names them and variants carries each project's own numbers; project (a list) counts only those projects - with the same numbers per test as squally-get-test-metrics - runs, stability, flakyRate, failureRate, time lost, median duration - ranked worst first by the chosen sort (default: lowest stability). There is no verdict and no status - the tool labels no test; you judge the numbers. Moderate - two queries over the period, paged; for a single test use squally-get-test-metrics.

branch.description: Only runs on this branch, the name exactly. Every branch when absent.

days.description: The period, in days, ending now. Must not exceed the plan's retention (Standard 60, Pro 90 days); a longer period is refused with 400 invalid_period rather than answered with less data.

page.description: 1-based page number. A page past the end answers the last page.

project.description: Only these Playwright projects, each exactly as named (e.g. ["chromium"] or ["chromium", "firefox"]): each test then counts only those projects' variants. Every project when absent.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring of the test name or its file.

sort.description: Ranking, the worst first: stability (the default) lowest first; flakyRate, failureRate, runs and timeLost highest first. Ties go to the most runs (for runs: the lowest stability), then to the test name and file. A rate with nothing to divide by (null) sorts after every number.

source.description: Which runs count, by where they ran: all - every run (the default since 1.0.0-beta.18; ci before); ci - runs a shard reported a CI provider for; local - runs no shard did. The response's population names the one counted.

name: squally-list-tests

branch.description: The branch filter applied; null for every branch.

days.description: The period in days, ending at until.

branches.description: Every branch the test ran on in the period, code-point order, a null branch (a run whose CI sent none) last.

failedRuns.description: Of runs, those in which its final attempt failed in any project - failed wins over flaky.

failureRate.description: failedRuns / runs, a fraction from 0 to 1. null only when runs is 0.

flakyRate.description: flakyRuns / runs, a fraction from 0 to 1. null only when runs is 0.

flakyRuns.description: Of runs, those in which it passed only after a retry in some project and failed in none.

medianDurationMs.description: Per run the slowest project's final attempt, the median over the runs (the lower middle); null when no run names a duration (since 1.0.0-beta.19).

projects.description: Every Playwright project the test ran in, code-point order; empty when it ran under none. Replaces browser (1.0.0-beta.19).

recentResults.description: The test's last 20 runs in the period, oldest first, each over its projects: failed when it failed in any, flaky when it passed after a retry in one and failed in none, stable, or skipped when every project skipped. Empty when it has none.

branch.description: The run's branch; null when its CI sent none.

result.description: The run's final attempt - across all its shards - read through test.fail(): stable (passed on the first try), flaky (passed after at least one retry), failed, or skipped. A skipped run appears only here: it is not a run of the test, so it counts in neither runs nor any rate. A test the run's cancellation interrupted appears nowhere.

runId.description: The run, by the id GET /projects/{projectId}/runs gives it - one id for all shards of a sharded run (since 1.0.0-beta.6; it was the id of the shard the test ran in).

runs.description: Runs of the population in which the test has a final attempt that did not skip in any of its projects: stableRuns + flakyRuns + failedRuns. A sharded run counts once; per project, the final attempt is the one with the most retries, then from the lowest shard.

stability.description: stableRuns / runs, a fraction from 0 to 1. null only when runs is 0.

stableRuns.description: Of runs, those in which it passed on the first try wherever it ran.

testName.description: The test's name WITHOUT its Playwright project ("cart.spec.ts > adds an item" for chromium's and firefox's "<project> > cart.spec.ts > adds an item") - the identity GET /tests/{testName} takes. Since 1.0.0-beta.19; the stored name with its project, one item per project, before.

timeLostMs.description: Time spent on attempts that did not count, in ms, summed over runs and projects: a failed final attempt loses every attempt it made, one rescued by a retry the attempts before the pass, each at its own duration. 0 when every run passed on the first try.

topBranch.description: The branch with the most failed runs (kind failures, count = those runs); when no run failed, the branch with the most flaky runs (kind retries, count = those runs); null when neither. Ties go to the branch name in code-point order, a null branch last.

variants.description: One item per project's variant, project in code-point order (none last), each with its own numbers - the Test explorer's breakdown (since 1.0.0-beta.19).

medianDurationMs.description: The median of this project's final-attempt durations over its runs, the lower middle; null when none names one.

project.description: Its Playwright project; null for a result that ran under no named project.

runs.description: Runs of the population in which this project's final attempt did not skip.

testName.description: The variant's stored name: Playwright's title path, its project first - the name GET /runs/{runId} and the attempts route carry.

timeLostMs.description: This project's time lost - see the test's timeLostMs.

population.description: Which runs every number counts: runs whose shards all finished, each counted once however many shards it ran in, placed in the period by the start of their first shard - without runs that were a mass failure as a whole (at least 20 tests, over 80% of them failed). Every branch unless the branch parameter names one. A run finishes when all its shards have, or - once it is overdue by the project's run timeout, counted from its latest shard's start - when every shard that started has completed, timed out or been stopped by the monthly result limit; such a run counts like a cancelled one, with the results its shards reported (since 1.0.0-beta.10; the monthly result limit since 1.0.0-beta.11). Runs still running are not counted. The prefix names the source parameter: ci_ - CI runs (a shard reported a CI provider); local_ - runs no shard reported a CI provider for; all_ - both, the default since 1.0.0-beta.18 (ci_ before it; since 1.0.0-beta.8; before it, ci_groups_finished_not_mass_failure was the only value, and since 1.0.0-beta.6 - it was ci_completed_not_excluded, which counted every completed shard on its own).

projectFilter.description: The project filter applied - the project parameter's values, code-point order; empty for every project. Each item then holds only those projects' variants (since 1.0.0-beta.19; browser, one value, before).

since.description: Start of the period: until minus days. ISO-8601.

total.description: Tests matching the query across all pages - each test once across projects: every test with at least one run of the population in the period, narrowed by search, branch and project.

until.description: End of the period: when the numbers were computed. ISO-8601.

title: List tests
